name: Connector Scope Check
summary: Before connecting Gmail, Drive, Stripe, GitHub or calendar to a Grok Bot, runs a minimum-scope checklist and returns CLEAR or NEEDS ACTION. Never connects.
summary_zh: 在给 Grok Bot 接入 Gmail、Drive、Stripe、GitHub 或日历之前（或刚添加模板后），跑一遍最小权限检查清单，给出 CLEAR 或 NEEDS ACTION。自己从不连接。
